source_summary: A vertical Chinese landscape with layered ink-and-color mountains, mist-filled valleys, clustered hillside architecture, ravine groves, foreground water with a small boat and scholar, and lower-right pavilion among rocks and autumn trees. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: left_monumental_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large rounded mountain mass on the left, with stacked arcing ridgelines, pale blue-gray washes, dark ink texture strokes, and sparse pine marks along the slopes. Exclude the small houses and foreground trees at the lower edge.
must_preserve: dark clustered pine-needle marks on upper slopes

motifs.name: central_pine_ridge_blue_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the central layered ridge with tall pale blue peaks behind it and a darker pine-covered slope in front. Include the vertical tree trunks and dense ink pine clusters along the lower central ridge, but exclude the village roofs below.
must_preserve: ragged ink outlines on peak edges
thin vertical pine trunks at the ridge base

motifs.name: right_misty_cliffs_and_valley
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side mountain group: misty upright cliffs, rounded blue-gray hills, the deep white valley gap, descending stream path, and small bridge-like crossing near the lower valley. Exclude the lower-right pavilion complex.
must_preserve: soft white mist pockets between hills
dark scalloped vegetation marks along ridges
thin bridge and stream linework in the valley

motifs.name: central_hillside_village
motifs.description: Isolate the central cluster of hillside buildings on a rocky terrace, including multiple tiled roofs, timber wall lines, and adjacent pine-darkened rocks. Keep only the village group and its immediate supporting slope.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry and parallel tile lines
dark ink outlines of walls and posts
nearby pine dots and small shrubs framing the terrace

motifs.name: left_ravine_grove_hamlet
motifs.description: Isolate the left mid-to-foreground ravine with tall bare trees, dark bamboo-like groves, small roofed houses tucked into the slope, orange autumn foliage, and rugged rocks. Exclude the large mountain mass above and open water below.
must_preserve: thin vertical tree trunks and branch tracery
layered gray rock texture and wash transitions

motifs.name: foreground_river_boat_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground water surface with reed banks, the small covered boat at lower left, the seated boatman/passenger detail, and the standing scholar on the shore. Include the immediate shoreline and grasses, but exclude the large central tree and pavilion.
motifs.role: foreground river scene with boat and figure
must_preserve: small boat hull and canopy linework
tiny seated figure details in the boat
standing scholar silhouette and shoreline marks

motifs.name: foreground_autumn_tree_rock
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground autumn tree and rocky knoll near the center-right, including the twisting trunks, black branch network, pink-orange leaves, dark root-like rock strokes, and surrounding low shrubs. Exclude the pavilion behind it where possible.
must_preserve: root-like strokes merging tree and stone

motifs.name: lower_right_pavilion_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right pavilion group nestled between steep rocks, including the tiled roof, open wall bays, interior seated scholar figure, steps, adjacent shrubs, and enclosing dark-textured cliff forms. Exclude calligraphy and the central foreground tree except unavoidable overlapping branches.
must_preserve: crisp roof angles and tile hatching
open pavilion posts and wall geometry
dark dotted cliff texture and nearby red-green foliage accents

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
